appliedUpdates.description: Added mutation hook usage pattern (mutateAsync vs mutate convention) and route ordering convention to architecture.md

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Document route ordering convention: when adding nested routes under parameterized paths (e.g., /entities/:id/edit), always place specific literal routes before the :id parameter route to prevent path segment capture. React Router matches top-down.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: edit-entity-page worker correctly placed /entities/:id/edit before /entities/:id in router.tsx. This pattern is not documented and could trip up future workers adding routes like /entities/:id/relations/new.
